paragraphs: Mentioned in Niddah 15b: he questioned Rabbi Abba about Rabbi Yochanan’s words “even a young woman.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The named William Davidson vocalized Niddah 15b text explicitly has Rav Shmuel bar Yeiva asking Rabbi Abba about Rabbi Yochanan’s statement, “even a young woman,” adding that she is embarrassed to immerse. This supports the exact two abbreviated title expansions and noun reading ילדה, rather than the older she-gave-birth interpretation.
טו: gives Niddah 15b under the colon convention. The short Hyman notice compresses the exchange; no missing legal discussion or separate identity binding is supplied. Shmuel’s Rav is full in Hyman.
